semiconductor_relevance: High — Ningbo Hiper Technologies provides specialized equipment for silicon carbide crystal growth, which is crucial for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Ningbo Hiper Technologies Co.,Ltd. specializes in providing silicon carbide (SiC) crystal growth furnaces and porous graphite materials, essential for semiconductor manufacturing. They offer high-temperature vacuum furnaces for metal-organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) and have developed equipment for silicon carbide homoepitaxy.
capabilities: Horizontal and vertical epitaxial equipment for SiC
